plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: brand lockup, then the bottle, then a wide two-line text block (headline over subhead), ending in the CTA. Tighter gutters than the engine's version close its dead gap between the bottle and the copy.
Product-first: the bottle anchors the left edge with the headline and subhead tight beside it as one message block, and the logo and CTA sit together on the right as a brand-and-action sign-off.

Message-first: the logo opens the strip and the headline and subhead follow at full width, with the bottle placed right beside the Shop Now button so the product and the action read as one group at the end.
